close.reason: Phosphor's 'x' icon is the standard close/dismiss glyph

back.reason: Direct arrow-left icon for navigating back

next.reason: Direct arrow-right icon for navigating forward

external-link.reason: Phosphor uses 'arrow-square-out' for the external link concept (arrow exiting a square). Confirmed in Phosphor releases.

chevron-right.reason: Phosphor uses 'caret-right' rather than 'chevron-right'. Confirmed in Phosphor icon set.

chevron-down.reason: Phosphor uses 'caret-down' for the chevron-down concept

chevron-up.reason: Phosphor uses 'caret-up' for the chevron-up concept

chevron-left.reason: Phosphor uses 'caret-left' for the chevron-left concept

more.reason: Phosphor's 'dots-three' is a horizontal three-dot ellipsis icon for more options

more-options.reason: Phosphor's 'dots-three-vertical' is the vertical kebab menu icon

sidebar.reason: Phosphor has 'sidebar-simple' for a panel/drawer toggle. Preferred over 'sidebar' which shows a more complex layout.

columns.reason: Phosphor has a direct 'columns' icon for column layout views

anchor.reason: Phosphor has 'anchor-simple' which is a cleaner anchor glyph suitable for anchor links. Also has 'anchor' but 'anchor-simple' is more minimal.

user.reason: Direct match. Phosphor has a 'user' icon depicting a single person silhouette.

avatar.reason: Phosphor's 'user-circle' shows a user silhouette inside a circle, matching the avatar/account concept

users.reason: Direct match. Phosphor has a 'users' icon showing multiple people.

add-user.reason: Phosphor's 'user-plus' icon shows a user with a plus sign. Confirmed in release notes.

remove-user.reason: Phosphor's 'user-minus' icon shows a user with a minus sign. Confirmed in release notes.

assigned.reason: Phosphor's 'user-check' icon shows a user with a checkmark, suitable for verified/assigned user

admin.reason: Phosphor has no 'user-shield' icon. 'shield-check' conveys protected/admin status. Candidates: 'crown' (too regal), 'user-circle-gear' (too settings-like). 'shield-check' is the best available match for admin authority.

user-settings.reason: Phosphor's 'user-gear' icon shows a user with a gear, directly matching user settings. Confirmed in release notes.

anonymous.reason: Phosphor's 'detective' icon shows a figure with hat and magnifying glass, conveying incognito/anonymous. Confirmed in Phosphor set.

roles.reason: Phosphor's 'identification-badge' is a badge/ID card icon. Best fit for roles/permissions since Phosphor has no dedicated roles icon. Candidates: 'identification-card' (too literal for ID), 'user-list' (too many users). Badge conveys assigned identity/role.

login.reason: Phosphor's 'sign-in' icon shows an arrow entering a boundary, directly matching the login concept

logout.reason: Phosphor's 'sign-out' icon shows an arrow exiting a boundary, directly matching the logout concept

fingerprint.reason: Direct match. Phosphor has a 'fingerprint' icon for biometric authentication.

add.reason: Phosphor's 'plus' icon is the standard add/create glyph

edit.reason: Phosphor's 'pencil-simple' is a clean pencil icon for editing. Preferred over 'pencil' which has more detail.

delete.reason: Direct match. Phosphor has a 'trash' icon for delete/remove.

save.reason: Phosphor's 'floppy-disk' is the standard save icon. Confirmed in release notes with front/back variants.

check.reason: Direct match. Phosphor has a 'check' icon for confirm/done actions.

refresh.reason: Phosphor's 'arrows-clockwise' shows two arrows in a circular motion, ideal for refresh/sync. Candidates: 'arrow-clockwise' (single arrow, more like redo). 'arrows-clockwise' better conveys sync/refresh.

undo.reason: Phosphor's 'arrow-counter-clockwise' is a counter-clockwise curved arrow, the standard undo glyph

redo.reason: Phosphor's 'arrow-clockwise' is a clockwise curved arrow, the standard redo glyph

copy.reason: Direct match. Phosphor has a 'copy' icon showing overlapping documents.

clipboard.reason: Direct match. Phosphor has a 'clipboard' icon.

copied.reason: Phosphor has 'clipboard-check' showing a clipboard with a checkmark, indicating copied/confirmed state

paste.reason: Phosphor's 'clipboard-text' shows a clipboard with text content, the best match for paste. Phosphor has no dedicated 'paste' icon.

cut.reason: Direct match. Phosphor has a 'scissors' icon for the cut action.

move.reason: Phosphor's 'arrows-out-cardinal' shows four arrows pointing outward in cardinal directions, conveying movement/repositioning

drag-handle.reason: Phosphor's 'dots-six-vertical' shows a 2x3 grid of dots, the standard drag handle/grip pattern. Confirmed in release notes as a new addition.

upload.reason: Phosphor's 'upload-simple' is a clean upward arrow with a line, the standard upload glyph. Preferred over 'upload' which may have a tray.

download.reason: Phosphor's 'download-simple' is a clean downward arrow with a line, the standard download glyph. Preferred over 'download' which may have a tray.

import.reason: Phosphor has no dedicated 'import' icon. 'sign-in' (arrow entering a boundary) conveys bringing data in. Candidates: 'arrow-line-down' (too generic), 'download-simple' (conflicts with download). 'sign-in' is the best available match for importing data.

export.reason: Phosphor has no dedicated 'export' icon. 'sign-out' (arrow exiting a boundary) conveys sending data out. Candidates: 'arrow-line-up' (too generic), 'upload-simple' (conflicts with upload). 'sign-out' is the best available match for exporting data.

print.reason: Direct match. Phosphor has a 'printer' icon.

share.reason: Phosphor's 'share-network' shows connected nodes forming a share graph, the standard share icon pattern. Phosphor also has 'share' but 'share-network' is the more recognizable share glyph.

send.reason: Phosphor's 'paper-plane-tilt' is a tilted paper airplane, the standard send/submit icon. Preferred over 'paper-plane' for its more dynamic appearance.

zap.reason: Phosphor's 'lightning' icon is a lightning bolt, directly matching the fast/instant action concept

checkbox.reason: Phosphor's 'check-square' shows a square with a checkmark inside, the standard checked checkbox

checkbox-empty.reason: Phosphor's 'square' is an empty square, matching the unchecked checkbox state

toggle.reason: Phosphor's 'toggle-right' shows a toggle switch in the on position (knob to the right)

toggle-off.reason: Phosphor's 'toggle-left' shows a toggle switch in the off position (knob to the left)
